events.event: Komdigi said GitHub was inaccessible in Indonesia for about four hours after it blocked IP addresses, requested by a government agency over suspected malware attacks, that GitHub also used; the addresses were then removed from the block list.
events.key_numbers: About 4 hours of outage · statement published 9 Nov 2026 · access back to normal
events.why_it_matters: A blunt IP block took down the platform most Indonesian developers rely on, showing how easily government blocking can break normal services.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNBC Indonesia, detik, Warta Ekonomi and many others; on detikInet front page

events.event: Nvidia's board launched an independent-director investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after he confirmed an extramarital relationship with Alice Huang, a woman US media allege worked for Chinese intelligence; he remains CEO.
events.key_numbers: Nvidia lost US$450 billion market value in one day last week, regained 4% on Friday · Alice Huang's employer Megaspeed reportedly bought about US$4.8 billion of Nvidia equipment · House Republicans asked Huang to testify 18 Nov · NYT first reported 29 Oct
events.why_it_matters: The chip maker at the centre of the AI boom is shaken by a scandal that touches China chip exports and global tech stocks.
events.spreading_evidence: Roughly eight Nvidia-scandal headlines on the CNBC Indonesia Tech front page on 9 Nov

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported, citing Counterpoint and Omdia, that global smartphone shipments fell about 20% and tablet shipments 23% year on year in Q3 2026, blamed on memory-chip shortages and weak demand.
events.key_numbers: Smartphones -20% YoY, lowest Q3 since 2012 (Counterpoint) · tablets -23% YoY to about 32 million units (Omdia) · Apple tablets -28%, share 36% · Lenovo +12% · Omdia expects no significant tablet recovery before 2028
events.why_it_matters: The memory-chip crunch is making phones and tablets pricier and nobody is buying, which affects what Indonesians pay for their next gadget.

events.event: Komdigi warned buyers of Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta smart glasses, which go on sale in Indonesia on 11 November, to follow the Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) when recording other people.
events.key_numbers: On sale 11 Nov 2026 · prices from about Rp8 million (Rp8.79 million cited by one outlet) · UU PDP No. 27/2022 · models: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3, Oakley Meta HSTN and Vanguard
events.why_it_matters: Camera glasses that look like normal glasses arrive in two days, and the government is already saying secret recording can break the data law.

events.event: Bisnis Market reported data-centre projects are being halted or opposed across Southeast Asia, including BDX in Jatiluhur (no AMDAL or PBG) and water-shortage protests in Nongsa, Batam, as Thailand paused 49 projects.
events.key_numbers: Thailand: 49 projects halted and 117 more approvals suspended (Sept 2026) · BDX Jatiluhur, West Java halted for missing AMDAL/PBG · Nongsa, Batam water-shortage protests · Johor, Malaysia protest at ZData
events.why_it_matters: The AI data-centre boom Indonesia is courting is running into residents' water and power worries.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia Tech headline 'Data center projects halted in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand' on 9 Nov

events.event: CNBC Indonesia, citing blockchain investigator ZachXBT, reported the Credit Mutuel Arkea hack may have cost about US$133 million, which the bank has not confirmed; it says client assets were unaffected and some funds are frozen.
events.key_numbers: About US$133 million (about Rp2.4 trillion, unconfirmed) · about US$30 million stolen by 3 Nov per ZachXBT · bank disclosed 4 Nov · earlier Katadata figure: over EUR100 million
events.why_it_matters: A bank hack where the loss figure keeps changing shows how little customers are told in the first days.

gaps: CNBC Indonesia headline '40.000 PNS jadi korban peretasan' (9 Nov) appears to be the already-known US DHS leak (E0450), not Indonesian civil servants; not reported as new.
Perlinsos Digital launch (10 Nov) has no new development beyond E0208; the launch event itself could not be checked yet.
No ecommerce seller-rule, GoTo/Grab, Shopee/TikTok funding or telco news found in the last 48 hours; DailySocial page was stale (last item 30 Oct).
Arkea loss figures conflict across outlets (EUR100m+ per Katadata, US$133m per CNBC), unconfirmed by the bank.
